li.text: [[PLACEHOLDER stage 1 - the last stand]] Crater fields and slag hills on shattered megastructure floors. The emplacement rings all face one quarter of the sky, and the craters walk inward from it. Placeholder text; the authoring sitting owns the real words.

[[PLACEHOLDER stage 2 - the Sentinels]] Crater fields and slag hills on shattered megastructure floors. The machines that still patrol here cross the same ground in the same order, and none of their lines lead outward. Placeholder text; the authoring sitting owns the real words.

[[PLACEHOLDER stage 3 - the Cathedral]] Crater fields and slag hills on shattered megastructure floors. Every patrol line, every grave-ward and every dead projector ring is oriented on the same thing beyond the horizon. Placeholder text; the authoring sitting owns the real words.

[[PLACEHOLDER stage 4 - the deep record]] Crater fields and slag hills on shattered megastructure floors. The poisons here were not spilled; they were issued, in quantities and in a sequence, and the ground still holds the order. Placeholder text; the authoring sitting owns the real words.

[[PLACEHOLDER stage 5 - the pilgrims]] Crater fields and slag hills on shattered megastructure floors. The camps along the Ashfall Road all end facing the same direction, and nobody who made one walked back out. Placeholder text; the authoring sitting owns the real words.

[[PLACEHOLDER stage 2 warning]] Scarlands are inhabited by dangerous insects and rogue mechanoids. Water is toxic and scaria runs rampant among the animals. The Forgotten Sentinels defend the ground; they do not pursue past their lines, and they do not explain. You know now what they are guarding. Placeholder text; the authoring sitting owns the real words.

[[PLACEHOLDER stage 4 warning]] Scarlands are inhabited by dangerous insects and rogue mechanoids. Water is toxic and scaria runs rampant among the animals.
